settingsUpdatingStatusNotFound: Revision Tool is up to date
settingsCTDescription: Use light mode, dark mode, or the Windows setting
restartAppDialog: Restart the app to apply the changes
settingsLanguageDescription: Translations can be incomplete or incorrect
msstoreRingDescription: Select the update channel for package downloads
tweaksSecurityDefenderDescription: Protect your PC from security threats. Background protection can reduce performance
securityDialog: Turn off all protections before you turn off Windows Defender
tweaksSecurityHWMitigationDescription: Speculative-execution protection. The performance effect depends on the CPU generation
tweaksSecuritySMitigationDescription: Protect system memory from Spectre and Meltdown attacks
tweaksSecurityDownfallMitigationDescript: Protect sensitive data on affected Intel processors. You cannot turn off this protection while Hyper-V is on
tweaksSecuritySystemSafeguardsDescriptio: Account elevation prompts and system protection settings
tweaksSecurityUACDescription: Limit apps to standard-user permissions until an administrator approves elevation
tweaksSecurityVBSDescription: Use the hypervisor platform for core isolation, memory integrity, and other security features
tweaksSecurityMemoryIntegrityDescription: Protect kernel code and critical data with hypervisor-enforced checks. This setting also turns on VBS
tweaksSecurityCertsDescription: Update certificates to help fix certificate errors
tweaksSecurityCertsUpdateDialog: Root certificates are up to date. Try the software again. If the problem continues, contact support.
tweaksPerformancePowerPlanDescription: Optimize power settings for games and demanding apps
tweaksPerformanceCStatesDescription: Turn off CPU C6 states to reduce latency. This setting can use more power
tweaksPerformanceRdyBoostDescription: Support memory optimization, defragmentation, TRIM, and Superfetch. This service can increase latency. Superfetch stays off on SSDs
tweaksPerformanceMemoryCompressionDescri: Compress inactive memory pages to save memory. This setting can increase CPU use
tweaksPerformanceServiceGroupingDescript: Recommended is the ReviOS default. Forced uses less memory but can prevent features such as Xbox from working correctly
tweaksPerformanceServiceGroupingDialog: Forced mode can stop services such as Xbox. To undo the change, select Recommended.
tweaksPerformanceLastTimeAccess: Turn off NTFS last access time
tweaksPerformanceLastTimeAccessDescripti: Stop NTFS from recording when a file was last accessed. This setting reduces disk activity
tweaksPerformance8dot3NamingDescription: Stop NTFS from creating legacy 8.3 file names. This setting reduces disk activity and the attack surface
tweaksPerformancePagedPoolLimitDescripti: Use more memory to manage large numbers of files. This setting leaves less memory for apps and the system cache
tweaksPerformanceBADescription: Let apps run when you do not use them. Background apps use system resources. Some apps cannot show notifications when this setting is off
tweaksPerformanceBWMRDescription: Set how often background apps receive mouse and keyboard updates. 125 Hz improves response time. 50 Hz reduces background work but can affect hotkeys and idle detection
tweaksPerformanceCtfmonInputDescription: Limit CTFMon input monitoring to reduce background work. This setting hides the taskbar language bar and can affect IMEs, the touch keyboard, and advanced typing features
tweaksPerformanceFSODescription: Improve the performance of games and apps in fullscreen mode
tweaksPerformanceOWGDescription: Reduce frame latency in windowed and borderless DirectX 10 and 11 games
tweaksPerformanceMPODescription: Use dedicated GPU scanout planes to reduce latency. Turn off this setting if apps show display errors
tweaksPerformanceIntelTSXDescription: Use hardware transactional memory to improve multithreaded performance. This setting reduces security
tweaksPersonalizationNotificationsDescri: The Minimal option turns off notifications. The Full option removes Notification Center, including the calendar and notification panels
tweaksPersonalizationLegacyNotificationB: Show taskbar notifications as balloons instead of toasts
tweaksPersonalizationInkingAndTypingPers: Let Windows learn your typing history to improve text suggestions
tweaksPersonalizationScreenEdgeSwipeDesc: Turn off edge swipes to prevent taskbar pop-ups in fullscreen mode
tweaksPersonalizationExplorerHome: Show Home in the navigation pane
tweaksPersonalizationExplorerHomeDescrip: Show Home in the File Explorer navigation pane
tweaksPersonalizationExplorerGallery: Show Gallery in the navigation pane
tweaksPersonalizationExplorerGalleryDesc: Show Gallery in the File Explorer navigation pane
tweaksUtilitiesHibernateDescription: Save the current session to the hibernation file, and then turn off the device. This setting can cause problems with dual-boot systems and system upgrades
tweaksUtilitiesHibernateModeDescription:
Full: Supports hibernation and Fast Startup. Uses 40% of installed RAM for the hibernation file. You can add Hibernate to the power menu.

Reduced: Supports only Fast Startup. Uses 20% of installed RAM for the hibernation file. Removes Hibernate from the power menu.
tweaksUtilitiesFastStartupDescription: Save the system state to C:\hiberfil.sys to start Windows faster. This setting does not affect restarts and can cause problems with dual-boot systems and system upgrades
tweaksUtilitiesModernStandbyDescription: Keep the device connected and active in a low-power state
tweaksUtilitiesModernStandbyFullDescript: Modern Standby works only on supported devices. Turn it off if sleep or hibernation causes high temperatures or battery drain
tweaksUtilitiesTMMonitoringDescription: Turn on monitoring services for Task Manager
tweaksUtilitiesUsageReportingDescription: Report battery health and data use. This setting can reduce performance
tweaksUtilitiesUpdateKGLDescription: Update the Xbox Game Bar Known Game List (KGL). This can fix core-parking problems on dual-CCD processors
tweaksUpdatesWUPageDescription: If you enable this page, Windows also turns on update notifications
tweaksUpdatesWUDriversDescription: To install drivers in ReviOS, check for updates manually in Settings. ReviOS does not support automatic updates
